notes: The Coach prompt gallery. `id` is the key both platforms use for their localized title and prompt (iOS *.xcstrings, Android strings.xml); `title_en` / `prompt_en` are the English source of truth those resources are seeded from and what the parity test compares. `requires` lists the data sources that must be effective (scripts/coach_reference.py resolve_data_sources) for the entry to be offered at all — an entry is hidden, never greyed out. Order inside a category is `order` ascending, then `id`.

prompts.prompt_en: Make me a diet chart using my health data. Use what you know about my intake, weight trend and activity, and explain why each meal is there.
prompts.title_en: Make a diet chart from my health data

prompts.prompt_en: How balanced are my macros over the last two weeks? Chart protein, carbs and fat and tell me what to change.
prompts.title_en: Are my macros balanced?

prompts.prompt_en: Based on what I have already eaten today, what should I have for dinner to stay on target?
prompts.title_en: What should I eat for dinner?

prompts.prompt_en: I want more protein without many more calories. Look at what I usually eat and suggest realistic swaps.
prompts.title_en: Help me hit my protein target

prompts.prompt_en: Review my last week of eating. What went well, what slipped, and what is the one thing to fix next week?
prompts.title_en: Review my week of eating

prompts.prompt_en: How do I improve my sleep cycle? Look at my bedtimes, wake times and sleep stages, chart the pattern, and give me a plan I can actually keep.
prompts.title_en: How do I improve my sleep cycle?

prompts.prompt_en: How did I sleep this week? Chart it night by night and tell me whether it is enough.
prompts.title_en: How did I sleep this week?

prompts.prompt_en: Is my sleep schedule consistent? Show me how much my bedtime moves around and what that is costing me.
prompts.title_en: Is my sleep schedule consistent?

prompts.prompt_en: Does my resting heart rate change with how I sleep? Compare the two over the last month.
prompts.title_en: Sleep and my resting heart rate

prompts.prompt_en: Analyze my last four weeks of training. Where am I progressing, where have I stalled, and what should next week look like?
prompts.title_en: Analyze my last 4 weeks of training

prompts.prompt_en: Am I moving enough? Chart my steps and active energy for the last month against what would be a good target for me.
prompts.title_en: Am I moving enough?

prompts.prompt_en: Chart how my main lifts have moved over the last three months and tell me what to push next.
prompts.title_en: How are my lifts progressing?

prompts.prompt_en: Am I recovering well between sessions? Look at my training load alongside my sleep and resting heart rate.
prompts.title_en: Am I recovering between sessions?

prompts.prompt_en: Explain my latest blood report: what stands out, what is normal, and what should I ask my doctor?
prompts.title_en: Explain my latest blood report

prompts.prompt_en: Find any abnormal values across my health records and tell me which ones are worth asking about.
prompts.title_en: Find abnormal values in my reports

prompts.prompt_en: Compare my latest report with the previous one. What changed, and does the direction matter?
prompts.title_en: Compare my last two reports

prompts.prompt_en: Chart how my key lab values have changed over time and explain the trend in plain language.
prompts.title_en: Chart my lab values over time

prompts.prompt_en: Based on my records, what should I ask at my next appointment? Keep it to a short list I can read out.
prompts.title_en: What should I ask my doctor?

prompts.prompt_en: Am I taking my medicines on time? Show my adherence for the last month and when I most often miss a dose.
prompts.title_en: Am I taking my medicines on time?

prompts.prompt_en: Walk me through my current medicines and when I am meant to take each one.
prompts.title_en: Explain my current schedule

prompts.prompt_en: Which doses do I miss most often, and what would make them easier to remember?
prompts.title_en: Which doses do I keep missing?

prompts.prompt_en: At my current rate, when do I reach my goal weight? Chart the projection and tell me what would move it.
prompts.title_en: When will I reach my goal?

prompts.prompt_en: Compare this month with last month across everything you can see, and chart what changed most.
prompts.title_en: Compare this month with last

prompts.prompt_en: If I could only change one habit this month, what does my data say it should be?
prompts.title_en: One thing to change this month

prompts.prompt_en: Put my whole picture together: intake, movement, sleep, labs and medicines. What is the headline?
prompts.title_en: Give me the whole picture
